issues.description: The problem statement UML and the solution use a Stock method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), but the template's Stock class defines the corresponding method as addItem(StockIngredient). This discrepancy can confuse students when they try to follow the specification (which names the method addToStockIngredients) vs. the provided starter code (which exposes addItem).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by renaming the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient). Alternatively, update the problem statement UML to reference addItem if that name is preferred, so all artifacts use the same identifier.
